results.name: Protection
results.description: The fortress was built to keep something safe. Whatever that something is, it is no secret that it resides in the fortress.

results.name: Hiding
results.description: The fortress was built to keep something from being found.

results.name: Hint
results.description: The fortress was built to act as a clue to some greater mystery.

results.name: Instruction
results.description: The fortress was built with a lesson in mind, to teach those who would look upon it.

results.name: Imprisonment
results.description: The fortress was built to prevent something from getting into others’ hands, or from being unleashed on the wider world.

results.name: Connection
results.description: The fortress was built to accommodate a magical or extraplanar portal.
